Motor Components.name: Copper
Motor Components.reasoning: Primary electrical conductor used for windings in the motor; copper's excellent electrical conductivity and thermal performance make it the industry standard.

Motor Components.name: Iron
Motor Components.reasoning: Core material for the stator and rotor laminations due to its magnetic properties; essential for efficient electromagnetic flux conduction.

Motor Components.name: Silicon
Motor Components.reasoning: Used as an additive in electrical steel (silicon steel) to improve magnetic properties and reduce core losses in motor laminations; very common but small variance possible.

Motor Components.name: Aluminum
Motor Components.reasoning: May be used in some rotor designs or as part of structural components for weight reduction; alternatives exist including steel or copper for conductors.
